name: github-aw
summary: Track a real factory task through GitHub Actions
runtime_note: See [usage and dispatch receipts](usage.md). Set `ORC_FACTORY_SCOPE` to the scope containing `factory-docs-credentials`. Set `ORC_FACTORY_RUN_URL` to its run URL and `ORC_FACTORY_PR_URL` to its draft PR URL. The recording observes existing resources without dispatching another task.
